company.name: Newfront
company.shortDescription: Newfront is an insurance company that provides risk control, risk analytics, and benchmarking claims advocacy.
company.description: Newfront provides business insurance, employee benefits, total rewards, and retirement services through a platform that blends brokerage services with proprietary technology. The company supports organizations by offering solutions for commercial insurance placement, compensation and benefits design, and centralized tools that help manage policies and total rewards programs efficiently. Newfront delivers data-driven insights, digital dashboards, and AI-enabled tools that streamline tasks such as vendor selection, compliance tracking, and coverage analysis. Its offerings aim to help sales development and HR teams assess market trends, optimize risk strategies, and coordinate employee benefit plans. The services integrate real-time information across insurance and rewards programs to support decision-making without focusing on promotional language.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $200,000,000, or 64.52% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $14,102,723 to $2,200,000,000, a 156x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
